info.title: Veyndo b2b: Company procurement: organisations, budgets, approvals and quotes
info.description: Generated by scripts/sdks/contracts.py; do not edit. HTTP bodies are open JSON (the handlers take serde_json::Value); typed schemas are the native MCP tool contracts in x-veyndo-tools, called through POST /mcp.

Problem.description: One safe, actionable failure; never contains SQL or provider payloads.

code.description: HTTP status code as a string (compatible legacy field)

Tenant.name: x-tenant
Tenant.description: Shop ID. Required for shop-scoped calls without a session that already selects one.

personalSession.description: Personal merchant session token from POST /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register.

integrationKey.description: Scoped integration key from POST /api/workspace/integrations; intersects its creator's current membership.
